integrity: Every public claim is supported by a stated field-uniform proof, with explicit scope and computational boundaries. No independently validated status is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem fixes one rank-one idempotent and counts rank-s partners, not arbitrary-rank pairs. Finite tests supplement, but do not replace, the algebraic proof; unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
title: Trace-conditioned commutator rank distributions of finite-field idempotents
